earDirectionalSupport.interpretation: All fixed ear vertices are sampled against the outermost front-facing face surface along actual head-local outward X. Positive offset is outward of that directional support; it is not a signed shortest distance or penetration depth. Baseline attachment candidates lie inside or within0.005 world units outward. Missing AFTER hits are counted separately as lost directional support, with no infinite or inferred numeric gap. Released bins include both finite offsets beyond the band and missing AFTER support. This does not prove an anatomical weld or continuous attachment.

earFaceOnlyRays.interpretation: Front-facing continuous-face triangles only, sampled at every fixed ear vertex. Rays use the already-rendered orthographic view directions. Face-ahead, coincident, face-behind and no-hit are explicit. Ear self-occlusion, hair, alpha coverage, lighting and pixel visibility are excluded; these are not whole-scene visibility or burial claims.

interfaces.interpretation: Endpoint contacts on actually changed finite face/neck triangles versus bounds-overlapping fixed ear/eye/hair/cloth triangles. Contact threshold uses unsigned distance, not penetration depth. Null near-distance values mean no evaluated pair within0.001; they are not unbounded clearance measurements. Alpha/culling do not remove triangles from contact counts. Actual witnesses locate changed contacts; a few examples never certify global burial. The common-field face/neck pair is not retested; both received the same verified world map, and the existing155 native art/orientation gates remain separate.
